findings.label: LLM body read outside the timeout
findings.detail: src/llm.js post() clears the AbortController timer when response headers arrive; res.json()/readSome() then read the body with no bound, so a stalled provider hangs run() until the Actions 20-minute job timeout and that cycle commits nothing. Keep the controller armed through the body read or race the body read against the remaining budget. Only affects runs with a configured LLM key.

findings.label: Operand-word guard fails the run on LLM text
findings.detail: src/schema.js validateDigest throws on /\b(?:undefined|NaN|null)\b/ in any why, including whySource 'llm' lines; an LLM sentence containing the word 'null' passes editorialize() and then crashes run() before any file is written. Apply the same regex in editorialize() as a per-line rejection (keep the heuristic line) so validation never sees it.

findings.label: s and r keys on Brief entries
findings.detail: app.js: 's' on a Brief entry does nothing unless items.json has already been loaded (it is lazy), and 'r' toggles is-read on .entry which styles.css does not style. Build the saved snapshot from the digest entry's own fields (title, url, sourceNames, publishedAt, category) and add an .entry.is-read rule. Plan mandates only j/k on brief entries.

findings.label: Prior digest with bad scalar fields fails the run
findings.detail: src/pipeline.js loadPrevious accepts any digest with matching date and sections/itemIds arrays; a damaged wordCount/readingMinutes/generatedAt reaches validateDigestIndex and throws, failing the run. Run validateDigest in loadPrevious and skip with a warning (verification note 8 already claims this behaviour). Low likelihood: only the pipeline writes digests.

findings.label: Backstop and run budget untested
findings.detail: No test exercises runSource's 45 s WallClockError path or the 8-minute 'run budget exceeded' path; the failed-row shape they produce is asserted nowhere. Add a test with a never-resolving fetchImpl and a fake nowMs, or export the backstop so tests can shorten it.

findings.label: Body decoding ignores declared charsets
findings.detail: src/http.js readBody always decodes as UTF-8; a feed declaring ISO-8859-1 would show mojibake. All 64 probed sources are UTF-8 today. Informational.
